newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha pulled higher by crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha pulled higher by crude gains.

text.p: NWE naphtha strengthened on the back of higher crude prices on Tuesday in an otherwise quiet market, traders said.
May swaps were talked at $182.50/$183.50 cif NWE, while June paper was assessed at $184.50/$185.50.
Traders attributed the gains to higher crude futures. The June IPE Brent contract was trading 22 cents higher at $18.56 a barrel at 1216 GMT.
Gains in the Asian naphtha markets were also seen as supportive.
